title: Radial Equation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly write the differential equation for the radial wave function R(r) in the context of the given potential.

title: Boundary Conditions
description: Essential Criteria: The student must specify the correct boundary conditions for the radial wave function for bound states.

title: WKB Condition
description: Important Criteria: The student must provide the correct WKB eigenvalue condition for s-states in the potential.

title: Potential Substitution
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly substitute the potential V(r) into the WKB relation for bound states.

title: Minimum V0 Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive the minimum value of V0 for one bound state accurately.

title: Comparison with Exact Result
description: Optional Criteria: The student should compare their calculated V0 with the exact result for the exponential potential.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign errors in the energy expressions when applying the WKB method.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout their calculations.
